description: This file defines a web form code-behind class 'Dashboard' for an ASP.NET web application. It handles navigation events for buttons such as profile, leaderboard, start exam, and logout, primarily transferring the user to different pages.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: A partial class for the Dashboard page, handling user interaction events such as button clicks for navigation within the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does not implement any logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'Home' button is clicked; currently no implementation.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Profile' button click event, transfers user to UserProfile.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Leaderboard' button click event, transfers user to Leaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Start Exam' button click event, transfers user to StartExam.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Logout' button click event, transfers user to LoginPage.aspx.
